text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae claimed victory in the Teio 
Sho. Following this result, Copano Rickey 
sets her sights on her next target race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Wonder Acute declares her 
intent for revenge at the JBC Classic. 
Hokko Tarumae steps up to accept the 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A great senior who has continuously run on 
the front lines of dirt racing, Wonder 
Acute. Hokko Tarumae rejoices at having 
grown enough to compete against her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
